column3: MT 58:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. The Hebrew has “silence” (elem); NASB reads “O gods.”
Close to the Hebrew; “also” is rendered “No.”
Close to the Hebrew; “turn aside” is rendered “are estranged,” and “from the belly” as “from birth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the teeth of young lions” is rendered “the fangs of the young lions.”
The end of the verse is obscure (“like, let them be cut off”); NASB renders “let them be as headless shafts.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “Let them be.”
The Hebrew is obscure; NASB renders “He will sweep them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning alike.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “fruit” is rendered “a reward.”
